title: SmartBook book OCR benchmark dataset
description: One entry per physical book. groundTruth holds ONLY what is printed in the listed images (null / [] when not visible in any of them), written exactly as printed with Vietnamese tone marks. Values the annotator knows from elsewhere must NOT be entered: a prediction for an unprinted field is scored as a hallucination.

tags.description: Free labels reported separately, e.g. genre (vn-literature, translated, textbook, comic, reprint, multi-author), ISBN situation (isbn13, isbn10, no-isbn) and photo condition (clear, tilted, glare, small-print)

subtitle.description: Vietnamese subtitle only; not the foreign original title, not a volume number

authors.description: Authors / 'Nguyên tác'; never illustrators or translators

publisher.description: Nhà xuất bản, not the distributor / 'đơn vị liên kết'

publishedYear.description: Only an explicit publication year; print / deposit / copyright / registration years are null here

isbn13.description: ISBN-10 on the book is converted to ISBN-13; 893... retail EANs are null
